paragraphs: AI: "AI rapidly improving, could vastly boost U.S. GDP, Anthropic's Clark tells policymakers" (CNBC) leads the coverage. Also notable: "AI Could Reshape White-Collar Employment by 2030—and Wages May Be the Bigger Risk" (CEOWORLD magazine).

Financial: "Avalanche in Chile Kills Three Climbers Amid Rare Snowy Spring" (Bloomberg) leads the coverage. Also notable: "Officers responding to ‘mass casualty incident’ at Wichita sports complex involving a vehicle" (CNN).
